scopeLabel: Selected operational PbSe synthesis and isolation alternatives, two three-layer device architectures, graphene analytical preparations and source-linked characterization from all five main and five SI pages. general_background.title: Conversion of a nonmetal precursor
general_background.summary: Chalcogen and pnictogen precursors can differ in how they release or transfer the element during a reaction. Bonding, coordination and the reaction medium can influence the activation or transfer steps that make an element available for growth.
